fee_notes: $10,000 veteran discount available for U.S. military veterans with honorable discharge or active-duty personnel (51% ownership required if corporate entity). Multi-unit franchise fees reduced to $39,500 for second and subsequent franchises.
raw_excerpt: When you sign your franchise agreement, you must pay us $49,500 as the initial franchise fee. This fee is not refundable. We offer a $10,000 discount on your initial franchise fee if you are a U.S. military veteran who has received a discharge (other than dishonorable) or if you are active-duty personnel.
